column3: Close to the Hebrew; “May it be established” is rendered “May … be counted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will not eat” is rendered “do not let me eat.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders “loyalty” as “in kindness” and adds “It is.” The meaning is uncertain.
“At the hands of a rock” is rendered “by the sides of the rock.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
“O Yahweh, O Lord” is printed “O GOD, the Lord,” and “do not lay bare my life” is rendered “do not leave me defenseless.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The hands of the trap” is rendered “the jaws of the trap.”
NASB adds “safely,” and “his nets” is rendered “their own nets.”
